approach: Static recompilation of the original Windows x86 executable to native C, with compatibility layers and modern renderers
notes: Public native Windows release with the TRG launcher, importing the user's own compatible retail disc, Direct3D 11, Vulkan and software rendering, rendering up to 4K and true 21:9 and 32:9 ultrawide on Windows, a minimap with dinosaur tracking, compass and objective waypoints, Quick Save and Quick Load, built-in cheats, Dual Stow, enhanced dinosaur AI, graphics improvements, seven languages, SDL3 controller support and four supported original versions. The game also imports from an existing installation or a copy of the disc. A Custom Levels page imports community levels from ZIP, 7z, RAR or a folder, or plays them from linked external folders and Trespasser CE mod folders, and checks each one first, with Trespasser CE, ATX and Squirrel script compatibility; levels with limited compatibility start only after a warning. An experimental native Linux AppImage uses Vulkan or software rendering without Wine or Proton, but does not have the Windows native-resolution and ultrawide path; Steam Deck is experimental and not validated on hardware. No game files are included.
